title: TSV to JSON
description: Convert tab-separated values to JSON — header-row option, proper quoted-field parsing.
howto: Toggle whether the first row holds headers.
Copy it or download as data.json.

faqs.q: How are tabs inside fields handled?
faqs.a: Fields wrapped in double quotes may contain tabs and newlines; "" is an escaped quote.

faqs.q: What if there is no header row?
faqs.a: Untick the option and you get a JSON array of arrays instead of objects.
Duplicate header names get a numeric suffix (name, name_2) so no data is lost.
No — empty input simply clears the output.
